## Recovered observations

18 points (from FC-9A) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appc-b7`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: inset angle 52.55, tan theta 1.3059, cohesion 634.20; six markers match the nonzero FC-1D peaks; avg density and fit agree with all seven FC-1D tests (zero-stress marker not drawn); link inferred; captioned Dense (soil 4) but 54.2 pcf is Dr about 1.1; 52.55 is the 52.6 deg series of Vol. I text 2-66
- Codex: Computer fit; Avg. Density 54.20; phi 52.55; tan theta 1.3059; cohesion 634.20. Geometry and rate missing. Six nonzero-stress tests; n0 not plotted. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. C-9A, printed C-25, PDF 139
